fixtureSeedPolicy: Copy catalog entities; remove all seed claims/evidence/review/sync/timeline/changes/edges. No network, paid calls, production writes or shared-user database writes. Each case uses separate tmp SQLite. Actual authenticated FastAPI review/publication/research routes; every research belongs to viewer.
assertions: Only current public verified citations may support decision facts.
Every displayed comparison finding is exact localized cited Claim text; no generated numerical scores.
Every result is reopened with private owner; anonymous and other account cannot read; publishedSlug remains null.
Withdrawal/replacement invalidates saved advice without rewriting stored record.
Chinese and English decision output/cited findings use selected language.
Conflicting current prices, missing data, mixed object types and inactive prices cannot become definite recommendations.
